serial.summary: Actual production nested DOS compiler and8086 ASPECT UART IRQ across N/S/H/B flow. Checked proactive XOFF/XON for S/B, raw IRQ reception, retained numeric/BREAK state, native compiled bytecode, exact unread ASIO return, vectors/PIC/MCR/guards. No resident-renderer, physical modem or external BBS claim.

flow.summary: Actual DOS COM1/COM2 compiler pause/resume with IRQ and wrapped/preloaded queues. Rejected nested pause preserves count/ownership; full combined-flow preload releases RTS at low water, then receives new live IRQ bytes and returns exact raw suffix. N/S/H/B across four established fixtures; physical flow timing remains unproved.
